narrative:
This is a single-domain forest (corp.fabrikam-sample.test) with two sites, HQ-Site and Branch-Site, linked by one site link.
There are two external trust relationships: a bidirectional forest trust with partner.fabrikam-sample.test, and an inbound-only external trust from legacy-domain.fabrikam-sample.test.
All five FSMO roles are held by a single domain controller, DC01, which is a single point of failure for schema, naming, RID, PDC, and infrastructure operations.
DC03 is a read-only domain controller that is not assigned to any site, which will affect client referral behavior for that location.

anomalies.title: All FSMO roles on one DC
anomalies.detail: DC01 holds all five FSMO roles. Losing DC01 blocks schema changes, RID allocation, and PDC-dependent operations forest-wide until roles are seized.

anomalies.title: Domain controller with no site assignment
anomalies.detail: DC03 has no Site value, which can cause it to be skipped or mis-referred during site-aware client authentication.

anomalies.title: Inbound-only external trust
anomalies.detail: The trust with legacy-domain.fabrikam-sample.test is inbound only and not forest-transitive; confirm this is intentional and not a leftover from a migration.

anomalies.title: Workstations OU has no GPO ever linked
anomalies.detail: OU=Workstations has HasGpoLink = false, meaning no policy is currently enforced at that OU level.

documentationGaps: Trust to partner.fabrikam-sample.test exists but no description or business justification is recorded.
Trust to legacy-domain.fabrikam-sample.test exists but no description or business justification is recorded.
OU=Legacy under Servers has no description explaining its decommissioning timeline.
